title: Israeli Drone Strike on Rimal Neighborhood Kills 13-Year-Old Child
detail: An Israeli drone strike hit the Rimal neighborhood of western Gaza City on Thursday, September 3, 2026, killing one person — a 13-year-old child — and injuring several others. The strike came as Israeli forces continued daily operations across Gaza despite the ongoing ceasefire.

media.caption: Aftermath of an Israeli drone strike in the Rimal neighborhood of Gaza City, Sep 3, 2026

title: IDF Shoots Dead Two Palestinians Crossing Yellow Line Near Beit Lahia
detail: The Israeli military said it killed two Palestinians in the northern Gaza Strip near Beit Lahia on September 3, 2026, saying they had crossed the Yellow Line separating IDF-controlled parts of Gaza from the rest of the enclave. The killings brought the day's Gaza death toll to at least three, alongside the Rimal drone strike.

media.caption: IDF says it shot two Palestinians who crossed the Yellow Line near Beit Lahia, Sep 3, 2026

title: Ben Gvir Unveils 'Disengagement 710' Plan to Remove 1.86 Million Palestinians from Gaza
detail: Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir unveiled a plan dubbed 'Disengagement 710' on September 3, 2026, calling for the removal of roughly 1.86 million Palestinians from Gaza over seven years through what he termed 'voluntary emigration,' including a dedicated government ministry and emigration packages offering travel assistance and housing support. Targets call for 250,000 departures in year one and 1.1 million within three years. Ben Gvir said: 'Instead of illusions of peace now, we need actions of emigration now.' Forced displacement of a civilian population in occupied territory is considered a war crime under the Geneva Conventions; critics say the 'voluntary' framing does not change the coercive conditions (blockade, destruction, famine) under which any departures would occur.

media.caption: Itamar Ben Gvir unveils the 'Disengagement 710' plan to remove Gaza's population over seven years, Sep 3, 2026
